scope: Source-only greedy full-width accepted-prefix collection for prefix-aware active-vocabulary research. No speed evidence.
label_scope: Full-width sampler acceptance before EOS/cap truncation; not committed-output gain.
candidate: Fit source vocabulary using prefix-loss weights vs ordinary accepted-token frequency; compare at equal vocab budgets. Any online update must use only past verification. No guarantees under uncontrolled shifts.
novelty: Active vocabulary adaptation already exists; prefix-loss objective is a candidate distinction, not established novelty.
success: Target >10% end-to-end gain against fully retuned cheap static baselines, same target output checks, held-out prompts and paired engine repetitions. Do not count synthetic identity checks as speed evidence.
